idea-plugin.name: Project View Bottom Files
idea-plugin.description:
A high-performance IntelliJ Platform plugin that positions designated files (such as package-info.java) at the bottom of their parent directory in the Project Tool Window.

  • Folders Always on Top: Directories remain unaffected and stay at the top.
  • Alphabetical Ordering: All standard files remain strictly sorted A-Z.
  • Zero UI Latency: Uses $O(1)$ fast-path in-memory matching and dumb-mode resilience.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0 - Initial release with high-performance TreeStructureProvider and BottomPsiFileNode.
